title: Authenticated trusted-time attestation
$comment: The self-digest projection omits digest and the complete signature. The signing projection is the completed document with only signature.value omitted, prefixed by schemaVersion and a zero octet. Semantic validation must resolve sourceId in the pinned trusted-time contract, require keyId to equal that source's keyId, resolve the active trusted_time_authority key through the pinned authorization and revocation contracts, verify the signature and self-digest, bind requestNonce and subjectDigest to the verification request, require attestedAt < expiresAt, reject stale or future attestations outside the trusted-time contract limits, and reject lower or conflicting sequences. previousAttestationDigest is null only for sequence zero; otherwise it is the SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 canonical complete preceding attestation from the same source.
